The therapists constantly seemed to be in a rush. A manicure and pedicure are supposed to feel relaxing, but everything felt hurried and careless. My sister repeatedly requested the therapist during her foot massage to be gentler because it was becoming painful, but there was barely any sensitivity towards client comfort.

During my manicure, the therapist herself had long coffin nails, which kept poking into my skin while massaging my hands. It felt uncomfortable, unhygienic, and extremely unprofessional.

To make matters worse, there was constant disturbance from a child screaming, running around the salon, and loudly watching reels throughout the service. It completely ruined the atmosphere.
High prices alone do not create a luxury experience ,professionalism, hygiene, attentiveness, and respect for client comfort do.Why are the therapists always in a rush, pls give appointments according to the therapists schedule then instead of the client’s ..

Honestly, we feel stuck because we’ve already taken a membership, but the service quality has been consistently underwhelming for the amount being charged.

But, I trusted Jazzil, explained to him what I had in mind and he conjured that vision on my hair. He did some of his touches too. He is not someone who will let your crazy ideas get to you. He will explain why something won't work out, and what you should be doing instead. He does his expert work, but none without telling you or without getting your approval. I think that matters the most. Some specific additions he did to my hair, looked great when my hair grew longer and texture got finer. What I admire here, is the pure vision. I love this kind of creativity in people.

I had promised Jazzil that I would write a review after I have enough evidence of how good his services are and whether or not his vision suited me in the long run. Well, me writing the review is the proof that he excelled on both of these fronts.

Please keep up the good work, Jazzil. See ya.

Review left on my wife’s behalf (her own words):

Request traveller to India’s but My first time with a Lakme Salon although I have tried their make up.
I found them online and they were very near my hotel so I thought I would give them a try.  I tried to book online but did not get a response so booked over the phone.
When I arrived a was seen to straight away.  I had booked for a haircut and manicure/pedicure.  I wanted gel polish but only had two hours so dropped this option.
I was satisfied with the haircut and  manicure/pedicure.  My criticism is with the service received which resulted in me not leaving a tip and I will not go back again sadly.
I had two lovely ladies who did my manicure and pedicure at the same time.  Again I was made to feel guilty for asking for chocolate one.  They wanted me to go for very berry.  Again tried to make me feel guilty and told me I had not chosen the right one.  The lady who was doing my pedicure was called away as her brother was ill.  Hope he is better.  So I felt the end of this service was rushed.  As I did not go for gel the options for nail polish was limited and was in a rundown box that looked tatty.
The haircut - The lady who cut my hair wanted to upsell me a hair spa and treatment but I only wanted a cut a blow dry, she was clearly not happy with this.  I only had two hours and I have access to a spa at my gym so I was not interested.  She cut my hair but took a phonecall during the cut and then disappeared to go on her phone without telling me.  Not very good customer service. She did a blow dry but it did not last the evening.
Sadly I will not return but hopefully this feedback will help you to improve for the future and live up to the brand that Lakme has made over so many years.
